title: Act: Show execution action failures through actionError
summary: AdminApp keeps an actionError state set on failed actions and cleared on success
description: Add actionError state to AdminApp.tsx, set it in runExecutionAction's catch for non-401 errors, clear it on success, and pass it to ExecutionPanel as actionError.
acceptance_criteria: A failed action shows its message in the Execution region
A 401 still shows the token gate
A successful action clears the message
technical_constraints: Depends on the runExecutionAction helper from the handler unit
definition_of_done: npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend

steps.action: Add const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined); after the reloads state.

steps.lines: the helper added by the handlers unit
steps.action: In the try block call setActionError(undefined) after the action succeeds. In the catch block, if err is an ApiError with status 401 call handleError(err); otherwise call setActionError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Request failed').
steps.expected: Non-401 failures set actionError; 401 returns to the gate

steps.action: Add the prop actionError={actionError} to ExecutionPanel.
steps.expected: The message renders with role alert in the Execution region
